name: git remote
purpose: Link a local repository to a remote GitHub URL or inspect configured remotes.
syntax:
git remote add origin <URL>
git remote -v
explanation: 'git remote add origin <URL>' registers a remote repository under the nickname 'origin'. 'git remote -v' displays the fetch (download) and push (upload) URLs for configured remotes.

parameters.description: Registers a new remote repository nicknamed 'origin'.
Verbose — displays fetch and push URLs for all configured remotes.

example:
git remote add origin https://github.com/NST/test.git
git remote -v
whenToUse: When connecting a local Git repo to GitHub or verifying where push/pull points.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to add a remote before running git push.
